Quotient Quest styles

Each picture shows the same fight in a different art style. Only the style changes. Tap the styles you like, then copy the codes and send them to Claude.

The game draws the health bars and the math buttons with code, so ignore small errors in that text.

S1

Chunky 16-bit pixel

Pixel art is cheap to animate, and it stays sharp on every screen.

S2

HD-2D pixel with light

Pixel characters are cheap to animate. The light and depth need more work in the game engine.

S3

Ink-wash brush painting

Ink art looks unique. Each animation frame needs careful brush work, so animation costs more.

S4

Cel-shaded TV anime

This style animates well with cut-out parts. Each character needs more art than pixel art.

S5

Chibi cartoon mobile game

Chibi characters are easy to read on a small phone screen, and many new skins are easy to add.

S6

Watercolor storybook

Watercolor makes very beautiful backgrounds. Animated characters in this style need the most work.

No style picked yet.
